en.headline: FEHD and Customs inspect 50 hairy crab sellers with no contraventions found
en.dek: Joint blitz operations since 9 November checked source documents and health certificates at premises across districts to ensure compliance with food and trade description laws.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and Hong Kong Customs conducted joint blitz inspections of hairy crab selling points and reported on Thursday that 50 premises had been checked since 9 November.

Officers from the Centre for Food Safety, the Environmental Hygiene Branch and Customs examined source documents and health certificates to confirm the crabs complied with the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance and the Trade Descriptions Ordinance and were fit for consumption.
No contraventions were found during the operations. Staff also distributed leaflets reminding operators about food safety requirements.

The departments reminded the trade not to import or sell crabs of unknown origin and urged the public to buy from licensed premises. Reports of suspected breaches can be made to the FEHD hotline or Customs.

zh.headline: 食環署與海關巡查50間大閘蟹銷售處所 未發現違規
zh.dek: 自11月9日起的聯合突擊行動查核來源文件及衞生證明書，確保符合食物安全及商品說明規定。
body: 食物環境衞生署與香港海關周四公布，自11月9日起的聯合突擊巡查已檢查50個大閘蟹銷售處所。
食物安全中心、環境衞生部及海關人員查核大閘蟹的來源文件和衞生證明書，確認符合《公眾衞生及市政條例》及《商品說明條例》，並適宜供人食用。
行動中未發現違規。人員亦派發宣傳單張，提醒經營者注意食物安全規定。
兩署提醒業界勿進口或售賣來歷不明的大閘蟹，市民應光顧領有相關許可的商戶。如懷疑違規，可向食環署熱線或海關舉報。
